testNames: custom agents do not make bundled fast-mode workers fail validation

ai.title: Restrict base agent spawnable override to agents with spawn tools
ai.summary: The CLI agent loader no longer auto-appends user-defined agent IDs to `spawnableAgents` for bundled base agents that lack the ability to spawn subagents. Previously, any agent definition with an ID starting with 'base' received user IDs in its spawn list, which incorrectly added children to non-spawning workers like fast-mode agents. The updated logic in `loadAgentDefinitions` checks for the presence of `spawn_agents` or `spawn_agent_inline` in `toolNames`, or a `handleSteps` generator, to identify base agents that actually support spawning.
ai.evidence: In `cli/src/utils/local-agent-registry.ts`, the condition for auto-adding user agent IDs to `spawnableAgents` is tightened to require `def.toolNames?.includes('spawn_agents')`, `def.toolNames?.includes('spawn_agent_inline')`, or `def.handleSteps` in addition to the ID starting with 'base'.

eli5.text: The assistant now automatically adds your custom helpers to the main planning agent only when that agent is actually able to delegate tasks. Previously, your custom helpers were listed for every main agent starting with the word 'base', including simpler, non-delegating workers, which caused those workers to fail their setup checks if you had any custom helpers defined. This internal correction ensures that your personal helpers integrate smoothly with the main planning agent without breaking simpler, single-task workers.

ai.title: Rename ad fetch completed verdict fields to direct result and house
ai.summary: The `ADS_FETCH_COMPLETED_FIELDS` schema in `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts` renames `first_party_outcome` to `direct_result` and `house_outcome` to `house_result`, aligning the field names with the updated COD-760 stage verdict vocabulary. The doc comments are updated to list the new closed enum values, such as `served`, `skipped`, and `no_campaign_for_slot` for the direct book, and `served`, `skipped`, and `promo_disabled` for the house floor. The previous field names were shipped for only a short period and are now removed from the allowlist, which means existing Axiom queries using the old keys will no longer resolve.
ai.evidence: In `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts`, the `ADS_FETCH_COMPLETED_FIELDS` schema renames `first_party_outcome` to `direct_result` and `house_outcome` to `house_result`, updating their doc comments to reflect new value vocabularies (e.g., `served`, `skipped`, `no_campaign_for_slot`); the test file asserts that the old names are no longer in `ADS_FETCH_COMPLETED_FIELD_NAMES`.

ai.title: GLM 5.3 Flash promotional price label
ai.summary: A new leaf module in the common package defines GLM_V53_FLASH_PROMOTIONAL, which the model catalog now assigns to the promotional field of the GLM 5.3 Flash row. The label renders as a temporary promotional price notice in the CLI and Desktop pickers, distinguishing it from a fixed end-date deal. The leaf structure follows the pattern of existing promo modules to prevent circular dependencies between the Freebucks price map and the model catalog.

ai.unknowns: The diff does not show the server-side price map change that sets the actual 10 Freebucks hourly rate.
